title: R3.0D Capability Ledger
note: Defines each capability the R3.0D phase of the Integrated Delivery Train may eventually enable, its kind, and the earliest checkpoint at which it may be unlocked. A capability being DEFINED here does NOT mean it is ENABLED. Enablement is governed by governance/r3.0d/state.json (enabledCapabilities). Per SKYLINE 2026-06-28 R3.0 Final Continuous Execution Directive §2.D, the 5-phase D-flow is: D1 Contract Foundation → D2 Evidence Graph → D3 Hypothesis Engine → D4 Priority Engine → D5 Engineer Brief + UI + Activation. D5 combines Engineer Brief, UI surface, and Feature Registry activation into one checkpoint per the directive.

contract_foundation_present.description: R3.0D D1 contracts present under contracts/r3.0d/ (Evidence / Hypothesis / Recommendation / Engineer Brief / SourceIdentity / Credibility). NON-PRODUCTION at D1: no rendererAdapter, no runtime consumer, no algorithm.

governance_bootstrap_present.description: R3.0D Integrated Delivery Governance scaffold present: schema, state, capabilities, checkpoint-manifest schema, and integration with the train-level validators.

evidence_graph_present.description: Renderer module renderer/js/r3-0d-evidence-graph.js that consumes ONLY D1 sanitized snapshots and produces the deep-frozen, deterministic Evidence Graph (dedup by nodeId + semantic fingerprint, correlation grouping with 1/N independence weight, orphan + cycle detection over causal edges, closed edge enum {supports, contradicts, derived_from, correlated_with, invalidates}). Non-LLM, deterministic, injectable clock, no UI.

hypothesis_engine_present.description: Renderer module that derives Hypothesis objects from the D2 authoritative graph snapshot using a closed rule registry. Deterministic; contradiction-aware; correlation-aware; freshness-aware; no LLM. Preserves the 6-category enum verbatim (data_quality / mapping_calibration / driver_behaviour / vehicle_response / setup_model / unknown).

priority_engine_present.description: Priority engine that ranks hypotheses per the fixed priority ladder (data_quality → mapping/calibration → controlled_repeat_lap → driver_experiment → setup_experiment). Outputs primary + secondary + blocking prerequisites + stopCondition + rollbackCondition. Deterministic; cost / reversibility / safety / expected-information-gain aware.

engineer_brief_present.description: Engineer Brief generator producing a structured object (primary issue / secondary issue / evidence summary / contradictions / alternative explanations / cannotConclude / recommended next validation / driver experiment / setup experiment / credibility / confidence / provenance / limitations). NEVER markdown; UI renders the structure. NEVER LLM free text. State invalidates on case/session/mapping/calibration/telemetry change.

feature_registry_active.description: Feature Registry registers the R3.0D feature IDs (decision_engine / hypothesis / engineer_brief — final names confirmed at D5 authorization time) as available, attaching their rendererAdapter and orchestrator. Combined with engineer_brief_present at D5 per the directive.
